mapper.select: SELECT * FROM biz.wcs_station WHERE station_type = #{stationType} ORDER BY station_id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz.wcs_station ( station_id, station_type, status, status_changed_at ) VALUES ( #{stationId}, COALESCE(#{stationType}, 'INBOUND'), #{status}, #{changedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (station_id) DO UPDATE SET station_type = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.station_type, biz.wcs_station.station_type), status = EXCLUDED.status, status_changed_at = EXCLUDED.status_changed_at, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE biz.wcs_station SET status = #{status}, cur_eqp_pallet_id = #{curEqpPalletId}, status_changed_at = #{changedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE station_id = #{stationId}
UPDATE biz.wcs_station SET status = 'AVAILABLE', cur_eqp_pallet_id = NULL, status_changed_at = #{changedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE cur_eqp_pallet_id = #{eqpPalletId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM biz.wcs_station ORDER BY station_type, station_id
